name: Hattori Hanzo
subtitle: Second Hanzo
description: Hattori Hanzo is a master Cunning hero whose skills focus on swift movement and debilitating strikes. His unique ability to manipulate enemy turn meters, coupled with his high critical damage output, makes him a formidable assassin on the battlefield. Hanzo excels at singling out high-priority targets and eliminating them quickly.
lore: Samurai and shinobi, swordsman and spy, Hattori Hanzo can purportedly enter any stronghold and slay any foe. Since the Shattering, he divides his efforts between Izumo and other realms. In the latter he targets any who threaten Izumo, but when in his home Realm he devotes his time to thwarting Oda Nobunaga, against whom he holds a longstanding vendetta.
